# Python Lab snapshots

These files are copies from https://github.com/CypherMonkeyLabs/python-lab-free-university-mesmerizing at the commit in `SOURCE_COMMIT.txt`.

The lab's code is MIT. See `LICENSE`. Lesson text from that repo is CC BY-NC-SA and is not in this folder.

- `aurora.js` is imported by `../../globe.js`.
- `fx.js` is the particle-field reference. CMFX does not import it. `../../particles.js` adapts the drift loop and documents the changes.
